result.sql: select distinct orgnr from fct_accounts

with newest as (
    select orgnr, max(fiscal_year) as fiscal_year
    from fct_accounts
    where accounts_type = 'company'
    group by orgnr
),
latest as (
    select a.orgnr, a.fiscal_year, a.equity, a.revenue_nok, a.operating_profit_nok
    from fct_accounts a
    join newest n on n.orgnr = a.orgnr and n.fiscal_year = a.fiscal_year
    where a.accounts_type = 'company'
)
select
    c.orgnr,
    c.name,
    case
        when c.is_bankrupt then 'The register has it as bankrupt.'
        when l.equity < 0 then
            'Equity was negative in the ' || cast(l.fiscal_year as varchar) || ' accounts.'
        else
            'Equity is under a tenth of revenue in '
            || cast(l.fiscal_year as varchar) || '.'
    end as reason,
    l.fiscal_year,
    l.equity,
    l.revenue_nok,
    l.operating_profit_nok,
    c.employees,
    c.is_bankrupt
from dim_companies c
left join latest l on l.orgnr = c.orgnr
where c.is_bankrupt
   or l.equity < 0
   or (l.revenue_nok > 0 and l.equity < 0.1 * l.revenue_nok)
order by c.is_bankrupt desc, l.equity
